narrative.intro: Harris shows $938M in contract obligations for FY2026 to date, across 11 awards with an average award size of $85.3M and obligations up 2.2% year over year. Fiscal-year obligations have trended upward from $376M in FY21 to $938M in FY26, with a notable jump to $918M in FY25 followed by a further increase to $938M in FY26. The FY2026 total is a fiscal year to date figure, so full-year totals may change as the year progresses. Contracting activity for Harris is concentrated in relatively few, large awards: 11 awards account for the $938M so far, which produces the $85.3M average award size. Year-over-year change is positive, showing obligations up 2.2% from the prior comparable period. Readers who track vendor performance should note the steady multi-year rise in obligations and the company’s reliance on large-value awards to drive year-to-date totals.

sections.heading: How has Harris’s federal business changed recently?
sections.body: Harris’s obligations rose to $938M in FY26 to date, up 2.2% year over year. Harris moved from $918M in FY25 to $938M in FY26, continuing an upward trend that began with $376M in FY21. Harris’s activity is concentrated in 11 awards, producing an average award size of $85.3M. Harris’s FY26 total is a fiscal year to date figure and not a full-year total.

sections.heading: How are Harris’s obligations distributed across recent fiscal years?
sections.body: Harris’s fiscal-year obligations by year are: $376M in FY21, $313M in FY22, $386M in FY23, $459M in FY24, $918M in FY25, and $938M in FY26. Harris shows the largest single-year jump between FY24 and FY25. Harris’s most recent year, FY26, is listed as a fiscal year to date total. Harris’s awards count for FY26 to date is 11, which yields the $85.3M average award size.
